QuestInfo.name: To the Energy Laboratory
QuestInfo.0: A Mapler who seems to have arrived before you is hiding amongst the grass.\r\nYou should start a conversation.
QuestInfo.1: You discovered the location of the Crystanol Fragment. You must take the portal to the right of #b#p9250130##k and continue until you reach the Energy Laboratory. If you meet aliens on the way, hide in the grass.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived at the Energy Laboratory. \r\nBut there is an Anti-Theft Laser preventing your approach. What to do?

0.0: Did you come in a Time Machine? I just got here myself, a few hours ago. Things are crazy in the future!\r\n#L0##bWhat do you mean?#l\n#k
0.1: Aliens! Aliens everywhere! The world has been overrun by aliens! It's awful! \r\n#L0##bNo... That can't be... We must change this!#l\n#k
0.2: Don't just stand there! They'll find you! \r\n#L0##bWhat do you suggest I do then?#l\n#k
0.3: Hide! Hide in the grass, like me. If you see any aliens around, hide in the grass, quick as you can. \r\n#L0##bI'll do that. Thanks for the tip.#l\n#k
0.4: I suppose you're looking for a #b#t4001458##k, too, right?\r\n#L0##bYes. Have you found any?#l\n#k
0.5: SHHHHHHHH!!! NOT SO LOUD!!!! \r\n#L0##bMy apologies... (It's like the pot calling the kettle black. Sheesh.)#l\n#k
0.6: That's better. \r\nNow, I've found out a few things. Want to hear?

yes.0: It turns out, the future Doctor Bing indeed manage to create Crystanol. I've even found out where he keeps it. Someone who obtained some earlier told me...
yes.1: Just take that portal to the right. Follow the path until you get to the Energy Laboratory. It's in there.
yes.2: Problem is, that building's crawling with aliens. Guess they like Crystanol, too. \r\nSecurity's tight, so you'll have to be careful.
yes.3: I'm still getting my bearings. \r\nYou go on ahead.

no.0: Suit yourself. Just keep your head down and don't let them find me.

1.0: Argh. Grrr. How am I supposed to get inside? Argh! Grrr! \r\n#L0##bHi there...#l\n#k
1.1: EEP! You scared the living daylights out of me! I thought you were an alien!\r\n#L0##bPeople around here seem awfully jumpy. Sorry for scaring you.#l\n#k
1.2: I'm surprised another human made it this far. You must be stronger than you look. \r\n#L0##bEr... Thank you?#l\n#k
1.3: I guess you're here to get some Crystanol, too.

yes.0: Unfortunately, this place is covered with a web of anti-theft lasers.
yes.1: I think we can pass through using the #bTeleport Device#k located here, but I can't get it to work. Looks as if the power is off.
yes.2: So, what now? \r\nIf we stay here beyond the #b<Time Restriction>#k, the aliens will find us for sure...
